message.content:
{
  "summary": "An anomaly alarm was raised for PCA.SPE with AIT-201 and AIT-201B as top contributors, indicating a potential issue with the pH probes in the pH correction tank due to probe disagreement or fouling. AIT-201 reads 7.37 pH and AIT-201B reads 7.04 pH, showing an active divergence.",
  "likely_causes": [
    "Fouling of the probe by dye, fibre lint or calcium deposits.",
    "Reference junction poisoning, or an ageing electrode past its service life.",
    "Water in the cable gland or a damaged probe cable."
  ],
  "checks": [
    "Take a grab sample from the pH correction tank and measure it with the calibrated hand-held meter.",
    "Compare the hand-held reading with AIT-201, AIT-201B and the discharge pH AIT-501.",
    "Check when each probe was last calibrated (calibration log) and whether it is due.",
    "Inspect the probe for coating and the cable for damage.",
    "Compare the control probe AIT-201 with the check probe AIT-201B."
  ],
  "handover": "Investigated PCA.SPE anomaly alarm driven by AIT-201 and AIT-201B disagreement in the pH correction tank. Verified current probe readings of 7.37 pH and 7.04 pH and recommended proceeding with SOP-03 immediate checks.",
  "citations": [
    "SOP-03 3.2",
    "SOP-03 3.3",
    "SOP-03 3.4",
    "SOP-02 2.4"
  ]
}
